description: This file contains functions and logic related to managing chunking metadata, identifying amplifier nodes, and reordering nodes within a computational graph for auto-chunking in PyTorch's FX framework.

classes.name: ChunkingMeta
classes.description: Class representing metadata for chunking operations, including methods to check for 'nop' state.

methods.name: set_chunking_meta
methods.description: Sets or overrides the chunking metadata for a given node.

methods.name: update_chunking_meta
methods.description: Updates existing chunking metadata for a node, preserving existing values if not overridden.

methods.name: set_chunking_meta_if_none
methods.description: Sets chunking metadata for nodes that do not already have it, with optional filtering for 'nop' state.

methods.name: copy_chunking_meta
methods.description: Copies chunking metadata from a source node or ChunkingMeta to a destination node.

methods.name: get_chunking_meta
methods.description: Retrieves the chunking metadata associated with a node.

methods.name: has_nop_chunking_meta
methods.description: Checks if a node has 'nop' chunking metadata.

methods.name: get_chunking_metas
methods.description: Retrieves chunking metadata for a sequence of nodes, optionally skipping None values.

methods.name: find_amplifier_node
methods.description: Identifies the 'amplifier' node in a graph that produces a large output from small/medium input, based on size ratios.

methods.name: reorder_nodes
methods.description: Reorders nodes in a graph to group pre-chunking, chunking, and post-chunking nodes for fallback or optimization.
